name: zoom
label: Zoom
desc: Zoom integration allows you to retrieve users, user settings, permissions, and presence status; list and inspect meetings and past meeting participants; and pull security audit reports (sign in/out activity, operation logs, active/inactive hosts). It also supports remediation actions: activating or deactivating a user, revoking a user's SSO token to force sign-out, and deleting a meeting. Authentication is via Server-to-Server OAuth.
